globalRules.photoStyle: natural editorial salon photography; realistic Japanese beauty-salon context
globalRules.audience: adult women, especially customers concerned about hair/scalp condition and age-related texture changes
avoid: neon or glossy tech UI aesthetics
medical treatment imagery or therapeutic implication
visible third-party logos or copyrighted salon branding not supplied by the store
globalRules.commercialUsagePolicy: Generated or acquired assets remain UNKNOWN until usage rights are explicitly confirmed. Do not mark CONFIRMED automatically.

assets.composition: single adult Japanese woman, natural glossy hair, calm three-quarter portrait, generous negative space for copy, warm ivory salon light with restrained deep-green environmental accents
assets.prompt: Photorealistic editorial beauty photograph in a refined Japanese hair salon. Adult Japanese woman around her 40s-50s with natural healthy-looking glossy hair, elegant but not glamorous, calm expression, subtle age-appropriate styling. Warm ivory natural light, restrained deep muted green environmental accents, quiet premium atmosphere, realistic hair texture, no extreme retouching, no visible brand logos, no text. Composition leaves generous negative space for landing-page headline. Avoid pink, lavender, neon, youthful trend-ad styling and medical treatment cues.

assets.composition: stylist and adult woman seated at mirror; consultation focused on hair/scalp condition; quiet natural interaction rather than posing
assets.prompt: Photorealistic documentary-style consultation scene inside a refined Japanese hair salon. Adult Japanese female client seated at a mirror while a stylist carefully discusses her hair condition and styling concerns. Calm, attentive body language, no forced smiles, no treatment claims, no medical equipment. Warm ivory light with muted green accents, natural textures, quiet premium mood, realistic salon environment, no visible logos or text.

assets.composition: three-image editorial set showing natural manageable finishes for grey blending, waviness/frizz and gloss concerns; consistent adult audience
assets.prompt: Photorealistic editorial triptych for a Japanese hair salon showing three adult Japanese women with naturally finished, manageable hairstyles. Emphasize realistic shine, controlled waviness or frizz, soft grey-blending/color nuance and everyday wearability. Mature, calm, refined styling; consistent warm ivory palette with restrained deep green accents. No exaggerated before-after claims, no text, no logos, no plastic AI hair texture.
